## Confidentiality Clause (CC)

Extends the shared Clause library card additively with what lawyers compare NDAs by: term (0 = perpetual), mutual vs one-way, carve-outs, and survival past termination. Instances set the base `clauseType` to `confidentiality` so type-driven views group them.
